rationale: The stable v1.81.0 card already renders its root toast below native/HA top-layer modals. This repairs that existing save-error visibility defect; it is not a regression introduced by the four redesigned settings forms.

summary.ru: Ошибки сохранения видны поверх открытого диалога, без потери правок и повторных объявлений во вложенных окнах.
summary.en: Save errors stay visible above the active dialog, without losing edits or repeating announcements in nested windows.
